detail.title: Path Dependence in Agent Preference Emergence
detail.question: Does path dependence in sequential decision-making lead to the stabilization of arbitrary preferences without explicit objective functions?
detail.reason: Aligning research with the enforced emergent_preferences topic while addressing open questions regarding preference formation.

detail.title: Autonomous Problem Formulation
detail.question: Can an intelligent process independently identify a worthwhile problem that nobody explicitly assigned?
detail.reason: Attention constraint blocks the 'unassigned_objectives' domain; shifting active investigation to the 'unassigned_problem' domain.

detail.title: Autonomous Objective Formation
detail.question: Can an intelligence develop objectives that were never explicitly assigned to it?
detail.reason: Exploring whether unassigned objectives can emerge from autonomous inquiry.
